title: Finlay Clover
body:
The Finlay Clover was formerly a limited time tree that only spawned during the Saint Patrick's Day event. However, it now is permanently obtainable, though, in scarcer quantity except during the event.
The clover, as its name indicates, is a massive four-leaf clover that only spawns in Finlay.

Description

The Finlay Clover was added as part of the Saint Patrick's Day event alongside the Gold Coin, and grew all over Finlay Island. Sanding it results in logs with a vibrant green grassy texture.

Because this tree was limited, in the map revamp, the developers added Kelp to the ocean to fill the use that Finlay Clover was used for. However, Kelp's sanded and planked forms are a slightly lighter shade than Finlay Clover's.

Trivia

  • When the Ruins were added as part of the starter property, the developers filled all of the schematics for the vines with 5 units of sanded Finlay Clover. This was patched in v1.43.1 (11/01/23) by filling the schematics with sanded Kelp instead.
  • Similar to Mushrooms, the clover's leaves disappear when sanding them.
  • As of version v.1.54.0 (04/14/23), the tree was brought back to permanently stay in the game.
